verdict.rationale: The API exposes core workflows also present in the UI (incorporation, notarization, translation, tax registration, trade registration, webhooks) matching many marketing/UI features, and docs explicitly frame these as programmatic equivalents of manual dashboard actions. However, several UI-advertised features (apostilles, eID/video identity verification, free business account bundling) have no corresponding API endpoint in the evidence, and the Compliance API is restricted to Enterprise plans, plus no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found (404s), suggesting incomplete API parity with the full UI feature set. missing for 10: apostille API endpoint, identity-verification API endpoint, confirmed OpenAPI/spec availability, parity confirmation for Enterprise-gated Compliance features.
